<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex040012026-09-0405-34-33" status="unreviewed">de ltar na rgyu 'bras don du grub par
            'gyur pa las pa'i nas la yod do zhe na | ngo bo nyid kyi sku blo che la yang thungs ste
            | dri ba don daM du grub par 'gyur ro || dri ma dang bral pa'i don mthong yang dri ma dang bral ba'o zhes rtog pa °° pas <pb n="247a"/>
            <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="247a1"/> dri ma don daM du grub par mi 'gyur ro zhe na | rgyu 'bras kyis khyad par du byas pa'i chos kyi dbyings gyi don rtogs kyang des rtog pa med pas rgyu 'bras don dam du grub par mi 'gyur ro zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3921">tho</rs> zer te | dri ma dang sparl ba'i sku mhong ba la dri ma mthong mi dgos pa ste | dri ma de ngo bo nyid myi sku'i khyad bar du byed hcos ma yin pas so || 
            des na ° hyogs su buM pa dben pa mthong ba la buM pa mthong mi dgos pa bzhin no zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3864">skyabs</rs> <expan>gsung ngo</expan> ||</seg></TEI>
